AntiPattern.Bad: `enum OrderState { NEW, PAID, SHIPPED }`; `class OrderManager { constructor(private repo: OrderRepo) {} #lastState: OrderState = OrderState.NEW; public process(orderId: string) {} }`.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: `enum` breaks under native Node TS (`AX_NO_TRANSPILE_ONLY_CONSTRUCTS`). Constructor parameter property `private repo` transpile-only. `#lastState` blocks reflection (`AX_TRUTHFUL_ENCAPSULATION`). `OrderManager` is semantic noise (`AX_TELEOLOGICAL_NAMING`). `process` generic verb (`AX_VERB_PRECISION`). `public` redundant.
